acceptanceCriteria: Role.Priority and the dispatch config reference state lower values win.
Config validation and dispatch status report a shadowed-role warning for the #994 repro, and none for non-overlapping roles; tests cover both.
Launch ordering is unchanged; focused dispatch tests and doc-gates pass.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#994. roster.go sorts matching candidates ascending by role priority, so the lowest value wins; Role.Priority in internal/tasks/dispatch/config.go:208 does not say so and config validation (config.go:524) does not warn. Repro: broad role worker priority 50 match states [work]; specific role special priority 92 match idGlob T-001[0-4] states [work]; T-0011 launches under worker with no warning. Fix: document lower-wins on Role.Priority, the config reference and the dispatch spec; emit a deterministic warning at config validation and in dispatch status when a role with narrowing (idGlob etc.) is always beaten by a role whose match is a superset with a lower priority value (conservative superset check, no false positives); optionally show the winning role per ticket. Ordering semantics must not change.
title: dispatch: role priority is lower-wins but undocumented; a narrower role can be silently shadowed by a broader lower-value role (#994)
